description:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This is an exceptional opportunity to make a significant impact within a facility dedicated to providing high-quality patient care and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff.

As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and success of the facility, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards and driving operational excellence. This role offers a competitive salary and the chance to lead a dedicated team in a challenging yet rewarding setting. We are looking for a visionary leader who can inspire staff and uphold the highest standards of care.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Proven experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, operations, and staff effectively.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive annual salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000, based on experience.
